relations.text: Twilioは、クラウド基盤の大部分をAmazon Web Servicesに委託している
relations.text_en: Twilio outsources a substantial majority of its cloud infrastructure to Amazon Web Services

source.label: Twilio 10-K
source.quote: For example, we outsource a substantial majority of our cloud infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), which hosts our products and platform.

relations.text: TwilioとMicrosoftが、Azure AI Foundryを基盤に会話型AIの顧客対応ソリューションを共同開発する
relations.text_en: Twilio and Microsoft will collaborate on conversational AI customer engagement solutions built on Microsoft Azure AI Foundry

source.label: Twilio の発表
source.quote: The two companies will collaborate on developing conversational AI customer engagement solutions built on Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Twilio’s comprehensive customer engagement platform that combines communications, contextual data, and AI.

relations.text: TwilioとGoogle Cloudが、長年の提携を拡大し、生成AIをTwilioの製品に取り入れると発表した
relations.text_en: Twilio and Google Cloud announced an expansion of their long-standing partnership to bring generative AI to Twilio's customer engagement products

source.label: Twilio の発表
source.quote: and Google Cloud today announced an expansion of their long-standing partnership to bring Google Cloud generative artificial intelligence (AI) to Twilio’s customer engagement products to improve experiences for millions of end users.

relations.text: TwilioがオランダのKPNと、TwilioとGoogleの技術を使ったRCSビジネスメッセージの提供で提携した
relations.text_en: Twilio announced a partnership with KPN Netherlands for RCS Business Messaging powered by Twilio and Google

source.label: Twilio の発表
source.quote: today announced at Mobile World Congress a partnership with KPN Netherlands (KPN) to enable nationwide Rich Communication Services (RCS) Business Messaging across all major mobile operators in the Netherlands, powered by Twilio and Google.
source.note: 提携の主体はKPNで、Googleは技術提供側として記載されています。
source.note_en: The partnership is with KPN; Google is named as the technology provider.

relations.text: TwilioがOpenAIと協力し、同社のRealtime APIをTwilioのプラットフォームに統合した
relations.text_en: Twilio announced an integration in collaboration with OpenAI to bring OpenAI's Realtime API to the Twilio platform

source.label: Twilio の発表
source.quote: announced an integration in collaboration with OpenAI to bring the company’s new Realtime API to the Twilio platform.

relations.text: Twilioの新機能は、Databricksおよびスノーフレークとの提携により、データ基盤側で直接クエリ処理を行える
relations.text_en: In partnership with Databricks and Snowflake, Twilio's new capabilities let customers push query processing down to the data warehouse or data platform

source.label: Twilio の発表
source.quote: In partnership with Databricks, the Data and AI company, and Snowflake, the Data Cloud company, the new capabilities will allow customers to push down query processing to the data warehouse or data platform directly
source.note: 同発表では未上場のDatabricksも併記されています。
source.note_en: The release also names Databricks, which is not listed.
